purpose: Replace the stale January 7-9 active/outbound planning count with named February events before using submarines in Eastern Fleet adjudication.

method.historical_event_inheritance: Allowed only where no recorded Branch divergence changes target route, escort composition, submarine availability or contact geometry.
method.no_hidden_survival: A named historical loss is retained unless a Branch-valid causal change is posted.

events.event: attacks convoy JC.36 in Bay of Bengal and is sunk by convoy escorts after damaging Asphalion
events.reason: No branch event changes the Colombo-Calcutta convoy/escort contact chain enough to justify survival.
events.operational_effect: Remove RO-110 from all 19-22 Feb patrol counts.

events.event: attacks convoy KR.8; Khedive Ismail is sunk; I-27 is then destroyed by Paladin/Petard
events.reason: Eastern Fleet reinforcement history leaves Paladin/Petard available to the same convoy-defense chain; no contrary branch posting exists.
events.operational_effect: Remove I-27 from all 19-22 Feb patrol counts.

events.event: fires two torpedoes at British Fusilier
events.operational_effect: Confirms a live Japanese patrol presence in the Indian Ocean/Bay system but creates no Allied shipping loss.

events.event: attacks British Chivalry south/southwest of Addu Atoll
events.operational_effect: Independent shipping loss in western/central Indian Ocean; contact is too far west and too stale to cue an attack on Operation SLEUTH on its departure day.

events.event: departs Penang on new Indian Ocean war patrol
events.operational_effect: Adds one outbound hull, not an immediate Ceylon weapon-quality contact.

events.event: late phase of Ceylon-area patrol; historical return Penang 23 Feb
events.operational_effect: May provide a weak Ceylon-sector cue if contact occurs, but no branch-valid contact with SLEUTH is generated by 22T24.

effective_named_picture_at_1944-02-22T24.planning_count_rule: Do not use the old ~7-9 January planning band as a February named roster. Use 4 named active/outbound relevant boats above plus separately traced additions only.
